details.description: Indulge in the irresistible crunch of Udhaiyam Fried Grams, a premium quality snack that is a staple in Indian cuisine. Versatile and easy to use, Udhaiyam Fried Grams can be sprinkled on salads, used as a topping, or enjoyed as a standalone snack. Carefully selected and processed, these split chickpeas are perfect for authentic Indian dishes and quick-cooking, ensuring a fresh and flavourful experience with every bite. Discover the perfect balance of taste and nutrition with Udhaiyam Fried Grams, a true delight for the senses.

details.description: Discover the authentic taste of South Indian cuisine with Udhaiyam Idly Rice. Crafted from the finest paddy fields, this premium quality rice is specially processed to deliver the perfect texture and flavour for delectable idlis every time. Traditionally made with a blend of idli rice and urad dal, this versatile rice can also be used to create fluffy dosas and other beloved South Indian delicacies. With its soft, pillowy consistency and superior nutritional profile, Udhaiyam Idly Rice is the ideal choice for a wholesome and flavourful breakfast. Bring home the goodness of this authentic rice and enjoy the comforting taste of homemade idlis, infused with the rich heritage of South Indian culinary traditions.

details.description:
Udhaiyam Asafoetida adds a distinct flavour to dishes.
Asafoetida also know as hing is an essential spice in Indian.
It is very pungent but gives a nice strong flavour to the food.
It smells like garlic and onions. It has been used in traditional medicine.
It used to aid digestion and gas. It is especially in curries and dals.
It enhances the flavour and aroma of your food.
Benefits
It is used to aid digestion and gas.
Hing is rich in fibre aids in digestion.
It enhances the taste and flavour of your food.
details.storageInstructions:
Store in a cool and hygienic place .
Transfer contents in to an airtight glass container.
This hing is perfect for a richer and stronger flavour in vegetable dishes.
Ideal for tempering vegetables, curries, lentils etc. 
Adds a robust flavour and an intense aroma to dishes.
